temperature_code_convention: XHIP V/137D main.dat SpT temperature code
interpolation: piecewise-linear in effective temperature between adjacent code anchors
citations: Anderson & Francis 2012, XHIP V/137D catalogue documentation
limitations: Anchors have not yet been empirically calibrated as a unified XHIP-code scale.
Unsupported or missing luminosity classes produce no assignment.
This mapping cannot support production-candidate status until calibration evidence is supplied.
